caption: The drawing depicts a lake shore with a wooden fence running parallel to the water. On the left, a brown rowboat with a person in a red top is on the water near a small dock. The shoreline has a path with green grass beside it. There are several trees in shades of green, light yellow, and dark green along the shore and surrounding a large chalet-style house. The house is brown with white window frames, a grey roof, and several windows. Behind and to the right of the house is a rocky, forested hill with green and dark brown textures. In the background, there are more green hills and distant mountains. The sky above is composed of horizontal streaks in pastel shades of blue, pink, purple, and light yellow, suggesting a sunset or sunrise. The whole image is rendered in a style with visible texture and angular, blocky patches of color. The image is bordered by a light-colored margin, and the artist's signature appears at the bottom right.
title: Landscape in Petit Point
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
